c: Cherry Bomb throws a small spinning bomb at the nearest enemy. The bomb travels in a straight line, bouncing off enemies, walls, and edges of the screen. They will decelerate and eventually stop; when they explode, they create a shockwave, flower petals, and a firework with a similar sound effect.
Depending on its level and the
stat, there is a chance for the bomb to explode.
